text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The day has finally come, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
This is your debut race. My heart feels
like it
might just burst!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If anything, we should be calling this
Super
Creek's debut race...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Do you have your handkerchief? What
about
tissues? Don't you go forgetting
things, now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to iron your clothes
perfectly
yesterday. Okay, time to head
out...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the crowd's cheers are so loud
that we can
hear them from in here. So
this is what a
racecourse is like...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you okay? Please don't be
afraid.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing to be scared of, see? If
you stay
calm, then I'm sure your
abilities will shine...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh, right... That's true. I'll be the one
running
in the middle of all these loud
cheers...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My heart's pounding all of a sudden.
What should
I do?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Just seeing your sparkling eyes
as you
say that reminds me...
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to your run!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to do my best. I can't let
you down.
